# Wiring

<!-- Generated by `python -m cad.generate` from cad/spec.py. Edit the spec, not this file. -->

Pin numbers are physical Raspberry Pi header positions (the Pi Zero 2 W pads are numbered the same way).
See `docs/drawings/04_wiring.svg` for the schematic.

| Type | From | To | Notes |
|------|------|----|-------|
| power | MPU-6050 IMU `VCC` | Pi pin 1 (3V3) |  |
| ground | MPU-6050 IMU `GND` | Pi pin 9 (GND) |  |
| i2c | MPU-6050 IMU `SDA` | Pi pin 3 (GPIO2 SDA) |  |
| i2c | MPU-6050 IMU `SCL` | Pi pin 5 (GPIO3 SCL) |  |
| gpio | MPU-6050 IMU `INT` | Pi pin 7 (GPIO4) | optional data-ready interrupt |
| gpio | Capture button `A` | Pi pin 11 (GPIO17) | internal pull-up, active low |
| ground | Capture button `B` | Pi pin 14 (GND) |  |
| power | TTP223 touch `VCC` | Pi pin 17 (3V3) |  |
| ground | TTP223 touch `GND` | Pi pin 20 (GND) |  |
| gpio | TTP223 touch `OUT` | Pi pin 13 (GPIO27) | active high |
| gpio | Privacy LED driver `CTRL` | Pi pin 15 (GPIO22) | 2N7002 gate, 100 k pull-down |
| power | Privacy LED driver `5V` | Pi pin 4 (5V) | via 100 ohm to LED anode |
| ground | Privacy LED driver `GND` | Pi pin 25 (GND) |  |
| power | INMP441 mic `VDD` | Pi pin 1 (3V3) |  |
| ground | INMP441 mic `GND` | Pi pin 30 (GND) |  |
| ground | INMP441 mic `L/R` | Pi pin 30 (GND) | selects the left channel |
| i2s | INMP441 mic `SCK` | Pi pin 12 (GPIO18 PCM_CLK) |  |
| i2s | INMP441 mic `WS` | Pi pin 35 (GPIO19 PCM_FS) |  |
| i2s | INMP441 mic `SD` | Pi pin 38 (GPIO20 PCM_DIN) |  |
| power | MAX98357A amp `VIN` | Pi pin 4 (5V) |  |
| ground | MAX98357A amp `GND` | Pi pin 34 (GND) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A amp `BCLK` | Pi pin 12 (GPIO18 PCM_CLK) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A amp `LRC` | Pi pin 35 (GPIO19 PCM_FS) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A amp `DIN` | Pi pin 40 (GPIO21 PCM_DOUT) |  |
| audio | MAX98357A amp `OUT+` | 1510 speaker `+` |  |
| audio | MAX98357A amp `OUT-` | 1510 speaker `-` |  |
| power | LiPo 1000 mAh `+` | PowerBoost 1000C `BAT` | JST-PH |
| ground | LiPo 1000 mAh `-` | PowerBoost 1000C `GND` |  |
| power | PowerBoost 1000C `5V` | Pi pin 2 (5V) | through the left hinge and brow bay |
| ground | PowerBoost 1000C `GND` | Pi pin 6 (GND) |  |
| gpio | PowerBoost 1000C `LBO` | Pi pin 16 (GPIO23) | via Schottky (cathode to LBO), pull-up on the Pi |
| gpio | PowerBoost 1000C `EN` | Power switch `COM` | EN low = off |
| ground | Power switch `NO` | PowerBoost 1000C `GND` |  |
| power | Micro-OLED driver `5V` | PowerBoost 1000C `5V` |  |
| ground | Micro-OLED driver `GND` | PowerBoost 1000C `GND` |  |
| video | OV5647 camera `CSI` | Pi CSI | 22-pin 0.5 mm FPC through the right hinge |
| video | Micro-OLED driver `HDMI` | Pi mini-HDMI | flat FPV ribbon, 1920x1080 side-by-side |
| video | Micro-OLED driver `OLED-L` | Micro-OLED left `MIPI` |  |
| video | Micro-OLED driver `OLED-R` | Micro-OLED right `MIPI` |  |

## Where each module lives

| Module | Location |
|--------|----------|
| MPU-6050 IMU | Brow bay |
| INMP441 mic | Brow bay |
| TTP223 touch | Right temple |
| Capture button | Right temple |
| Privacy LED driver | Left endpiece |
| MAX98357A amp | Right temple |
| 1510 speaker | Right temple |
| PowerBoost 1000C | Left temple |
| LiPo 1000 mAh | Left temple |
| Power switch | Left temple |
| OV5647 camera | Right endpiece |
| Micro-OLED driver | Brow bay |
| Micro-OLED left | Left optics |
| Micro-OLED right | Right optics |
